description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ballapana Udubage, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610008
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing the expungement of particulars for multiple parcels of land across different districts. It contains detailed land descriptions including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions, and administrative divisions. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters, specifically land title registration amendments, which is the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
